user_query: Which variants of LINE and LINE-SGD are limited to undirected graphs, and what proximity order does each variant use?
llm_response: The variants limited to undirected graphs are LINE-1st and LINE-SGD-1st, which use first-order proximity, and LINE-2nd and LINE-SGD-2nd, which use second-order proximity. In contrast, the combined LINE/LINE-SGD formulations are not restricted to undirected graphs in the same way because they can model directed edges via second-order proximity.
llm_confidence_reasoning: This matches the standard description of LINE: first-order proximity is for undirected graphs, while second-order proximity is used for directed graphs; the only uncertainty is the exact naming convention used in the source.
